measurement.share: E57's: (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11) from the cells summed over 128 maths rows of 256 tokens, KL(fine-tuned ‖ masked forward). K00: original subcomponents, W0's masks; K01: original subcomponents, the fine-tuned model's masks; K11: the least-squares split, the fine-tuned model's masks. Status 'scored' / 'unscored' / 'nan' by commute.qwen_reading.shares, unchanged from E57
measurement.states: E57's four updates (E40 step 10; gold step 100; anchor 2 seeds 0 and 1 step 100) and E57's two random changes (Gaussian off-span; random change on the live columns), each random change scaled to E40's KL on 16 rows by E57's search
measurement.blind_to: Reads 1 whenever K01 ≈ K11 ≪ K00, whatever the update did: on the old decomposition every update and both random changes read 0.993 to 0.9995. A high share says only that the masks Γ gives at the fine-tuned weights recover most of the output change, not that the update was a re-gating
measurement.noise_floor: The 95% interval of the share over resamples of the 128 rows, and the seed spread below. On old the row interval's width is 0.0005 to 0.0014 and the seed spread 0.0022

controls_stop_on_miss.W0: W0 as the fine-tuned model: K00 and K01 equal K0, and K10 and K11 under an all-zero split equal K0 on 16 rows, each within 1e-6 relative (CFG.id_tol, the tolerance these identities met in E57 stage A)
controls_stop_on_miss.E40_KL: KL(W0 ‖ W0 + E40 step 10) unmasked on the first 16 rows equals E57's 0.618376722326358 within 1e-3 relative (CFG.rep_tol, E57's). No decomposition enters it: this tests the weights, the rows and the card
controls_stop_on_miss.do_nothing: The do-nothing state through the split path on E40, 16 rows: share within 1e-6 of 1 (K10 = K00, K11 = K01 by construction)
controls_stop_on_miss.alive: The live set rebuilt from the saved statistics counts 500,244 (E131 Amendment 1 stage 1)
controls_stop_on_miss.stored_error: The fp32 split misses float64 by under 1e-3 of ‖δW‖_Σ at every state (E57's bar; E57 read about 1e-6)
controls_stop_on_miss.gpu: Peak under 44 GiB after the first row of each cell pass (E57's bar)

expected.W0_K0: Mean K0 near E131's masked KL on maths, 0.0728 on new (rows of 512; here 256, and on old the 256-token value was 1.18 x the 512-token one, so about 0.08). Logged, no stop

separation_rule.seed_spread: |share(a2long_s0) - share(a2long_s1)| on the same decomposition: the one saved seed pair with an old reading. Unreadable if either is not 'scored'
separation_rule.separated: A pair of states other than the seed pair is separated when both are 'scored', |share difference| > seed spread (strict), and the 95% interval over row resamples of the paired difference excludes 0. Otherwise not separated. A pair with an unscored state, or with no seed spread, is 'unreadable'
separation_rule.edge_cases_checked: Empty or one-element pool: does not arise, the state set is fixed at six. Zero spread: reduces to the interval test. Ties at exactly the spread: not separated. Zero denominator or under the floor: the state is unscored and its pairs unreadable. Do-nothing is the identity check, not a candidate, so it enters no pair: its share is 1 by construction
separation_rule.applied_to: new and old alike, from the per-row cell sums (old: E57's C0.json and C_*.json), so the two tables use one rule
separation_rule.reports: The answer is the count and names of separated update-update pairs and update-random pairs, on new and on old; not a pass or fail

leans.written_before_running: Every update and both random changes read at least 0.98 on new, as on old, so the largest update-to-update difference stays under 0.02. Update-to-update pairs of different arms may exceed the seed spread as they do on old (E40 against the anchor 2 seeds: 0.0065 against a spread of 0.0022), but no pair of updates is separated by more than 0.02
